proposal.summary: A partial blind CSRF in perfSONAR v4.x ≤ v4.4.5 allows attacker-controlled URL parameters on /perfsonar-graphs/ to make the client browser perform background XMLHTTPRequests to arbitrary sites, bypassing the whitelist. Patched in v4.4.6.
proposal.cwe_quote: A partial blind CSRF vulnerability exists in perfSONAR v4.x <= v4.4.5 within the /perfsonar-graphs/ test results page.

AV.quote:
Client browser connects to www.google.com in the background.
http://192.168.68.145/perfsonar-graphs/?source=1&dest=2&url=https://www.google.com

UI.quote: Parameters and values can be injected/passed via the URL parameter, forcing the client to connect unknowingly in the background to other sites via transparent XMLHTTPRequests.

A.quote:
Client browser connects to arbitrary IP and port in the background, passing delete parameter to /api endpoint.
http://192.168.68.145/perfsonar-graphs/?source=8.8.8.8&dest=%26action%3Ddelete&url=http://192.168.68.113:4444/api

proposal.recommended_next_step: Verify the behavior on a vulnerable instance by reproducing the provided example URLs and confirm the patch in v4.4.6 mitigates the injected XMLHTTPRequest; if confirmed, prepare advisory and coordinate disclosure.
